info.title: FUNCTION-DocTest-Create Payments Payments Charge-v5-spec
info.description: The Payment Processing API allows businesses to efficiently process customer payments through various methods. This endpoint enables the submission of payment charge requests, ensuring secure and swift transaction handling. It is primarily used by e-commerce platforms, financial service applications, and merchants looking to integrate payment functionalities. By utilizing this API, developers can enhance their applications with reliable payment processing capabilities, supporting a seamless customer experience.

post.summary: Charge a payment to the customer.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to process a payment charge for a customer. When invoked, it handles the transaction and provides the necessary response indicating the success or failure of the charge.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate a charge payment. It should contain the necessary details for processing the payment such as amount, currency, payment method, and any additional transaction-related information.

200.description: Request processed successfully, payment charge completed.

requestId.description: The unique identifier for the request.

referenceNumber.description: A reference number associated with the request.

customer.description: The details of the customer making the payment.

resource.description: The resource associated with the payment.

priority.description: The priority level of the request.

currency.description: The currency of the payment amount.

notificationRequired.description: Indicates if notification is required after the operation.

requestedAt.description: The timestamp when the payment was requested.

channel.description: The channel through which the payment is made.

recordIndex.description: The index of the record being processed.

CreatePaymentsPaymentsChargeRequest.description: Request body for the POST operation to charge payments.

firstName.description: The first name of the customer.

lastName.description: The last name of the customer.

email.description: The email address of the customer.

vipCustomer.description: Indicates if the customer is a VIP.
